scope: Predeployment static preview candidate; deployment/readback still pending

requirement_match.summary: Only isolated HTML/CSS and Hosting-only configuration for explicit satsunicplan site; approved copy and seven-day preview scope.

security.summary: No script/forms/data SDK/rewrites; strict CSP, noindex and privacy headers; deployment must skip Auth-domain synchronization.

code_quality.summary: Small semantic static page; no dependencies or application/backend edits. JSON config validated by browser verification helper.

failure_paths.summary: Malformed/unmapped local requests return 404. No asynchronous user flow exists. Strict CSP blocks inline styles as expected. Rollback limited to new task-owned channel.

error_handling.summary: No user input, network calls or timers. Verification fails on content/header/hash/layout mismatch. Deployment/readback failures remain blocking.

product_content.summary: All eight principles and applicable states reviewed using current screenshots and accessibility tree proxy.

production_readiness.summary: Candidate ready for approved static preview only. Live app readiness remains NOT_READY; before/after metadata and served hashes required.

trade_offs.summary: Static readiness page has no product functionality. No tracking/fonts/dependencies; no search indexing. No native screen-reader or full application tests claimed.

findings: F1: 200% text at 320px produced excessive wrapping because rem spacing scaled with text. Reduced viewport-based spacing and title minimum.
Verification helper initially attempted inline style injection; CSP correctly blocked it. Replaced with same-origin stylesheet fixture without weakening CSP.

cycles.verification: Fresh local browser checks and screenshot inspection after scoped CSS fix.

findings.verification: local-320-text-200.png shows readable full title and content; no overflow.

residual_risks: Remote readback pending; provider-side behavior is not proved by local checks.
